title: Production publish readiness: stable build version + robust service worker update flow

requirements.summary: Ensure production publish results in an updated frontend build indicator and a reliable service worker update banner/reload flow on mainnet.
acceptanceCriteria: The production app is accessible via the production frontend canister URL (https://<frontend-canister-id>.ic0.app).
The in-app build/version indicator in the footer shows a new build value after publish (different from the pre-publish value).
Service worker update flow functions in production: if an update is available, the update banner appears and reloading activates the latest assets without requiring an admin-only cache reset.

file_operations.description: Make the build/version identifier deterministic per deployed build (prefer an injected VITE_BUILD_VERSION), and avoid per-refresh randomness that can cause spurious version changes and service worker churn.

Align service worker registration/versioning with the deterministic build identifier and harden the update detection flow so that a newly deployed version reliably triggers an update-available state and reload activation in production.
Confirm the footer build/version indicator displays the deterministic build identifier and remains visible in production for post-publish verification.
Validate and, if needed, adjust cache versioning/activation behavior to ensure old caches are cleaned and the SKIP_WAITING + clients.claim + reload flow works smoothly after production publishes.

Update the mainnet publish instructions to include setting/injecting VITE_BUILD_VERSION during the production build, and add a brief smoke-test checklist item verifying (1) footer build indicator changes and (2) service worker update banner appears when a new build is published.
